loot.settlement: No generic post-combat payment established by the reachable-item trace. Do not duplicate campaign boss/room rewards.

explicit_blockers: Keep CR8/18d8+54 HP/AC17, three legendary resistances, Turn Resistance, seven spells and 4/3/3 slots. Do not substitute SRD Lich or remove finale as high CR.
Paralyzing Touch duration 1 has no unit/exit timing in seed. Pin current native interpretation separately before translation; do not import SRD Lich duration.

Rejuvenation requires a phylactery and a 1d10-day new body; source lacks represented phylactery and Crown win/revival policy. Preserve as blocked aftermath; no automatic ten-day simulation or campaign completion reversal.
Legendary Resistance (3/Day) needs exact replenishment schedule and optional failed-save window; no blanket immunity.

retained_runtime_observations.boundary: Read-only code observation, not gameplay verification: after a hit poison_save/restrain/paralyze_save call saving_throw_to_dc and add_condition with max(1,duration) turn count; corrode_armor adds AC-1 modifier for duration default10 rather than damaging a carried armor copy. reduce_max_hp uses existing damage receipt and direct maxHP mutation. Do not treat these simplified interpretations as source rules or replace them here.
